name: When should baseboard installation be planned during a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: When should baseboard installation be planned during a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Baseboard installation is typically one of the final steps in a renovation project, after flooring has been laid and walls have been painted. This sequence ensures that baseboards are cut and installed to precisely meet the new floor level and that their finish remains pristine, avoiding damage from earlier construction phases. As part of AKN Design Group's integrated design-build process, we coordinate the timing of this finishing work seamlessly within your overall project timeline, ensuring a cohesive and polished outcome for your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Baseboard installation is usually a final step in a renovation, after flooring and painting, to ensure a precise fit and pristine finish.
